provenance: Original published 2025 crop from the measured AA6016 T4 study; no source arrays modified. This is not the entire experimental volume or loading series.

files.processing: Author-published crop retained unchanged; example imports LabDCT only and leaves AbsorptionCT unread.

catalogue_discrepancy: The catalogue/tutorial state all grains have at least 27 voxels. The actual download contains grain 1049 with 23 voxels touching a crop face. The example preserves and flags it; historical cause is not established by the file.
packaging_status: Manual external inputs: the original 567,693,056-byte HDF5 and one 87-byte recipe-generated phase INI. Neither is added to normal data installation; packaging remains pending. A future package must reproduce the exact INI bytes and retain source-data attribution. A lossless smaller HDF5 derivative is a separate packaging decision.

onscale_dependents.input_type: Predecessor output; no additional source dataset.

onscale_dependents.pipeline: (03) Gille OnScale Import and Uniform Grid.d3dpipeline
onscale_dependents.input_type: Stage-02 predecessor table plus the manually authored GilleAluminum_Phases.ini; both must exist before preflight. No additional raw dataset.

authored_metadata_files.encoding: ASCII-compatible UTF-8 without BOM; LF endings including final LF
authored_metadata_files.availability: Create locally in the external working folder before stage-03 preflight. The README recipe accepts an existing canonical file and preserves any different file with an error. No download or repository payload is supplied.
authored_metadata_files.provenance: Example-authored transcription of the published source phase identity, with an explicit NX phase-role declaration. This is companion metadata for the measured ROI, not an author-supplied export or a new measurement.
authored_metadata_files.mapping: Source space group 225 / F m -3 m supports Cubic_High. PrimaryPhase is the example's declared NX role; the source does not supply this classification.
authored_metadata_files.phase_count: Number_Phases=1 counts one physical phase. ReadEnsembleInfo adds reserved row 0, yielding two ensemble rows; grain IDs and the 935 imported name slots are unrelated to this count.
authored_metadata_files.limitations: The reader imports no MaterialName, cell phase map, lattice constants, Hermann-Mauguin string or orientations. Existing inline names and the verified constant PhaseId=1 remain in the pipeline. Both numeric tables are indexed by PhaseId.
authored_metadata_files.attribution: Retain the existing Gille dataset attribution and SourceDataLicense.md with derived results.
